latin: Non omnis uoluntas dei beneplaciti est efficax.
translation: Not every will of God's good pleasure is efficacious.
translation_note: 'uoluntas beneplaciti' ('will of good pleasure') is a scholastic technical pairing with 'voluntas signi' ('will of the sign'); rendered literally (farmer1998:21953).
